title: H05 — Pearson Correlation (Easy)
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between house price and area. Ignore rows with missing values in either column. Report your answer in this exact format: @correlation_price_area[value] where value is a number between -1 and 1 rounded to two decimal places.
notes: Manual Pearson formula implementation; correct only because dataset happens to have no missing price/area values (missing-value guard uses math.isnan on an already-cast float, which would never trigger on truly missing data).
